note: Every limit this machine imposes, measured rather than assumed. Nothing in Go or in a script may carry one of these numbers: the 128 GB machine moves all of them at once, and docs/VISION.md calls a hardcoded machine limit a defect to fix rather than a value to update. docs/TECH.md says how each was measured.
